speakers.biographyMd: Daniele Zonca is a Distinguised Engineer working for Red Hat. He contributes to many open source projects like TrustyAI, KServe, vLLM and llm-d. He is the Chief Architect for Red Hat Openshift AI product and before this he led Big Data development team of one of the largest Italian bank.
